title: Workspace
summary: Navigation and imported content with a sticky header, footer, and optional controls sidebar.

APP.description: App labels and initial appearance. Supplied fields replace their defaults.

UI.description: Transient UI preferences; section status and icon are published by the native components.

DATA.description: Initial task data, shared by content and sidebar controls. Edits remain local until reload.

ROUTER.description: One route map drives navigation, the header title, and sym-import. Exactly one section must be default.
